tasks.subject: Task 0: Project scaffold
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A working uv project with Typer, ruff, pytest, pre-commit, justfile, CI, and an importable empty `bassify` package.

**Files:**
- Create: `pyproject.toml`, `justfile`, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `src/bassify/__init__.py`, `src/bassify/cli.py`
- Modify: `.gitignore` (append `out/` and `tracks/`)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `uv sync` succeeds and creates a lockfile.
- [ ] `uv run bassify --help` prints Typer help without error.
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .` pass.
- [ ] `uv run pytest` exits 0.
- [ ] `out/` and `tracks/` are gitignored.

**Verify:** `uv sync && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest -q` → all exit 0

```json:metadata
{"files": ["pyproject.toml", "justfile", ".pre-commit-config.yaml", ".github/workflows/ci.yml", "src/bassify/__init__.py", "src/bassify/cli.py", ".gitignore"], "verifyCommand": "uv sync && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest -q", "acceptanceCriteria": ["uv sync succeeds", "bassify --help works", "ruff check + format pass", "pytest exits 0", "out/ and tracks/ gitignored"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Slice spec + path resolution
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure, unit-tested `SliceSpec` (duration/start → suffix + ffmpeg args) and `resolve_paths()` producing every artifact path with the correct slice suffix.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/bassify/slice.py`, `src/bassify/paths.py`
- Test: `tests/test_slice.py`, `tests/test_paths.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `SliceSpec` renders suffixes: none→``, duration→`_d15s`, start→`_s30s`, both→`_d15s_s30s`.
- [ ] `SliceSpec.input_args()` returns `-ss` before `-t`, `[]` when empty.
- [ ] `resolve_paths()` derives collection=parent dir name, track=stem, builds all six artifact paths under `out/<collection>/<track>/` with suffix before extension.
- [ ] Integer floats render without `.0`; non-integers compact.

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/test_slice.py tests/test_paths.py -v` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/bassify/slice.py", "src/bassify/paths.py", "tests/test_slice.py", "tests/test_paths.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest tests/test_slice.py tests/test_paths.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["suffix rendering none/duration/start/both", "input_args -ss before -t", "resolve_paths six artifacts", "integer floats render without .0"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: ffmpeg/ffprobe helpers
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Shared subprocess helpers: `run_ffmpeg()`, `run_ffmpeg_capture()`, `ffprobe_duration()`, `should_skip()`.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/bassify/ffmpeg.py`
- Test: `tests/test_ffmpeg.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `run_ffmpeg(args)` prepends `ffmpeg -hide_banner -y` and prints the command before running.
- [ ] Non-zero exit raises `FfmpegError` with a stderr tail.
- [ ] `ffprobe_duration(path)` returns float; `parse_duration` raises on bad input.
- [ ] `should_skip(output, force)` True only when output exists and force False.

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/test_ffmpeg.py -v` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/bassify/ffmpeg.py", "tests/test_ffmpeg.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest tests/test_ffmpeg.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["run_ffmpeg prints + raises", "FfmpegError stderr tail", "ffprobe_duration float, parse_duration raises", "should_skip logic"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: extract stage + CLI
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implement L−R bass extraction to `bass.wav` with optional lowpass and slice, wired into Typer CLI as `bassify extract`.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/bassify/extract.py`
- Modify: `src/bassify/cli.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `extract_bass()` builds ffmpeg with `pan=mono|c0=c0-c1`, `-c:a pcm_s24le`, `-vn`, plus slice args when `cut_inputs` True.
- [ ] `--lowpass HZ` appends `,lowpass=f=HZ`; omitted by default.
- [ ] Output from `resolve_paths()`; parent dirs created; skip-if-exists.
- [ ] `bassify extract --help` shows all options.

**Verify:** `uv run bassify extract --help` exits 0 with all options.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/bassify/extract.py", "src/bassify/cli.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run bassify extract --help", "acceptanceCriteria": ["build_filter pan=mono c0=c0-c1 + lowpass", "pcm_s24le -vn + slice args", "resolve_paths + mkdir + skip", "CLI help"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: detect stage + CLI
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Parse ffmpeg `silencedetect` stderr into padded `(start,end)` windows (handling unpaired trailing starts), emit JSON, wire `bassify detect`.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/bassify/detect.py`
- Modify: `src/bassify/cli.py`
- Test: `tests/test_detect.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `parse_silences(stderr, duration)` pairs windows; unpaired trailing start closed at `duration`.
- [ ] Windows padded ±0.1s, clamped to `[0, duration]`.
- [ ] `detect_windows()` writes JSON list; skip-if-exists.
- [ ] `bassify detect --help` exposes threshold/min-gap/duration/start/force.

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/test_detect.py -v` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/bassify/detect.py", "src/bassify/cli.py", "tests/test_detect.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest tests/test_detect.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["parse_silences pairs", "trailing start closed at duration", "padding clamp", "JSON + skip", "CLI options"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: combine stage + CLI
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Build `between(t,...)` gate string from windows and mix gated original speech onto mono bass → `combined.wav`; wire `bassify combine`.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/bassify/combine.py`
- Modify: `src/bassify/cli.py`
- Test: `tests/test_combine.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `build_gate(windows)` returns `between(t,a,b)+...`; empty→`0`.
- [ ] `build_filtergraph()` gates original (mono) with `eval=frame`, mixes `amix=inputs=2:normalize=0`, output `[out]`.
- [ ] `combine_track()` reads JSON, writes mono `combined.wav`, skip-if-exists, warns on >0.1s mismatch when cut_inputs.
- [ ] `bassify combine --help` exposes duration/start/force/-o.

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/test_combine.py -v` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/bassify/combine.py", "src/bassify/cli.py", "tests/test_combine.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest tests/test_combine.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["build_gate + empty 0", "filtergraph eval=frame + amix + [out]", "combine_track mono + skip + warn", "CLI options"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/bassify/remix.py", "src/bassify/cli.py", "tests/test_remix.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest tests/test_remix.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["filtergraph pan c0=c1 + join stereo [out]", "remix_track stereo + skip + warn", "CLI options"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: encode stage + CLI
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Encode a WAV to AAC `.m4a`, carrying the original MP3's metadata and cover art; wire `bassify encode`.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/bassify/encode.py`
- Modify: `src/bassify/cli.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `encode_track()` builds `-map 0:a -map 1:v -c:a aac -b:a 256k -c:v copy -disposition:v attached_pic -map_metadata 1` (no `-vn`).
- [ ] Output `.m4a` defaults next to source WAV; parent dirs created; skip-if-exists.
- [ ] Missing cover art falls back to audio-only encode (no crash).
- [ ] `bassify encode --help` exposes -o, --force.

**Verify:** `uv run bassify encode --help` exits 0.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/bassify/encode.py", "src/bassify/cli.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run bassify encode --help", "acceptanceCriteria": ["aac 256k + attached_pic + map_metadata no -vn", "output .m4a + mkdir + skip", "art-missing fallback", "CLI options"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: run pipeline + CLI
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `run_pipeline()` chaining extract → detect → combine → remix → encode(×2), applying the ffmpeg time-cut only at extract and carrying the slice suffix through filenames; wire `bassify run`.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/bassify/pipeline.py`
- Modify: `src/bassify/cli.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `run_pipeline()` uses `resolve_paths()` outputs; intermediates land in `out/<collection>/<track>/`.
- [ ] `extract` gets `cut_inputs=True`; downstream get `cut_inputs=False` with same `slice_spec`.
- [ ] `encode` invoked twice: combined→combined.m4a, remix→remix.m4a.
- [ ] `bassify run --help` exposes all options; root help lists all six commands.

**Verify:** `uv run bassify --help && uv run bassify run --help` → exit 0.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/bassify/pipeline.py", "src/bassify/cli.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run bassify --help && uv run bassify run --help", "acceptanceCriteria": ["chains 5 stages via resolve_paths", "cut_inputs True only at extract", "encode twice", "CLI help complete"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 9: integration test (synthetic)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A marked integration test that synthesizes a tiny stereo WAV (L=bass tone+noise, R=noise only), runs extract, asserts L−R works; plus a full-pipeline slice artifact check. No committed audio.

**Files:**
- Create: `tests/test_integration.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Marked `@pytest.mark.integration`, skipped when ffmpeg/ffprobe absent.
- [ ] Generates synthetic stereo via ffmpeg lavfi, runs `extract_bass()`, asserts mono output.
- [ ] Runs full `run_pipeline()` with a short slice (monkeypatch.chdir tmp_path), checks all six artifacts exist with slice suffix.

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/test_integration.py -v && uv run pytest -q` → green or clean skip.


tasks.subject: Task 10: Interactive UAT on real tracks
tasks.description:
**Goal:** **USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

Run the pipeline against a real `tracks/BluesBass/` track and walk the user through listening/inspecting each stage.

**Files:**
- None (verification only).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `bassify run "tracks/BluesBass/01_The Twelve Bar Blues Form.mp3" --duration 30` exits 0 and produces all six `_d30s` artifacts under `out/BluesBass/01_The Twelve Bar Blues Form/`. Capture output + `ls`.
- [ ] extract: user confirms bass isolated/clean, records `--lowpass` decision.
- [ ] detect: user confirms windows land on real gaps; records threshold/min-gap change.
- [ ] combine: user confirms speech placement, no clicks, no 6 dB drop.
- [ ] remix: user confirms balance sweep + channel alignment.
- [ ] encode: ffprobe shows AAC + attached_pic + tags; user confirms playback.

**Verify:** `uv run bassify run "tracks/BluesBass/01_The Twelve Bar Blues Form.mp3" --duration 30 --force` → exit 0; then `ffprobe -hide_banner` on the combined .m4a shows AAC + attached_pic + metadata. User verbally confirms each per-stage criterion.
